verdict.rationale: Only indirect evidence exists: a community comment confirms Ollama's app supports multimodal (image+text) interaction as expected, but there is no first-party documentation enumerating vision-language model support, image API usage, or specific VLM models (e.g., llava, bakllava) in this evidence pack. Missing for 10: official docs on vision model support, API examples for image inputs, and broader hands-on corroboration of VLM performance/quality.
